Payout of 14 July is short ₹2,405.00.
The bank credited ₹2,83,615.41 against an expected ₹2,86,020.41. 21 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00002 of ₹2,405.00, raised 27 July. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00002 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00002 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
